---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea that improves VEXOR as a tool
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Problem to solve**

What does a pentester or bug bounty hunter have to do manually today that VEXOR should automate? A concrete scenario beats an abstract wish list.

**Proposed solution**

What would the CLI look like? Example:

```bash
vexor -u https://target.example.com -oob oob.yourdomain.com
```

**Alternatives considered**

Which existing tools or flags (in VEXOR or elsewhere) get close, and why they are not enough.

**Additional context**

Anything else — expected output shape, report format, performance constraints.
